description.value: Browns Socialhouse Victoria Falls was the first location of this BC-based chain on Vancouver Island, positioned at 'The Falls' development in the heart of downtown Victoria adjacent to the Empress Hotel and Victoria Conference Centre. It draws both locals and tourists with a social dining atmosphere, weekend brunch, and a daily social hour. The central location makes it a convenient refuelling stop for cyclists exploring downtown Victoria.
